current_prompt.body:
FIND a valid 4-coloring of wheel graph W_11 (12 nodes total: hub node 0 connected to nodes 1 through 11, with nodes 1‑11 forming a cycle 1‑2‑...‑11‑1) using colors {1,2,3,4} such that no adjacent nodes share the same color.
PROVE that a 3‑coloring is insufficient for this graph.
RETURN the color assignment for each node and a proof of insufficiency.

current_plan.body:
DEFINE the wheel graph W_11 with hub node 0 connected to peripheral nodes 1‑11 and a cycle among nodes 1‑11.
SELECT a graph‑coloring procedure that assigns colors from the set {1,2,3,4} while respecting adjacency constraints.
EXECUTE the procedure to search for a valid 4‑coloring of the defined graph.
VERIFY that no adjacent nodes share the same color in the resulting assignment.
STORE the color assigned to each node.
SELECT a similar graph‑coloring procedure constrained to the color set {1,2,3} to attempt a 3‑coloring.
EXECUTE the procedure to determine whether a valid 3‑coloring exists.
DETECT the inability to assign colors without conflict for the 3‑color case.
CONSTRUCT a proof of insufficiency based on the failure to find a 3‑coloring and the structural properties of the wheel graph W_11 that require four colors.
COMPILE the stored 4‑color assignment and the constructed proof into the final response.
